title: Analysis of pistachio shell-derived activated porous carbon materials for hydrogen adsorption
material_description: ACNC10-900 | pistachio-shell-derived activated carbon, 10 % (w/w) NaCl one-step chemical activation and carbonization at 900 C under N2; authors describe self-nitrogen doping (EDS N 37.41 wt%)
purification_method: washing then drying after carbonization (washing medium not stated)
activation_method: NaCl 10 % w/w: 3 g shells immersed in NaCl solution 1 day, air-dried 3 days, carbonized in sealed crucible under N2, 10 C/min to 900 C, held 30 min
functional_groups: C≡C (FTIR band near 2100 cm-1, authors' assignment); hydroxyl groups reported eliminated by carbonization
source_location: main p.7 (journal p.266), Fig. 9, series ACNC10-900, adsorption branch marker
notes: Digitized marker centre, archive: fig9_ACNC10-900.json. Pressure axis in kPa (digitized 35.0343 kPa), converted to bar; uptake in mmol/g as plotted, wt% computed as W1 from mmol/g. Branch from figure: points labelled Desorption (upper marker of a same-pressure pair, markers at 2.5-30 kPa above the dense curve) vs Adsorption (dense curve and lower markers). Isotherm: Micromeritics ASAP 2020, 77 K, to 120 kPa (Fig. 9, gray squares); measurement type (volumetric) is not named for this instrument, coded volumetric_sieverts from the instrument type. Point count left empty: markers of the dense 0-30 kPa adsorption band overlap and cannot be counted. Sample: no BET area or pore volume printed for ACNC10-900 (surface_area_method not_reported); Sect. 4.2 prints 279 and 579 m2/g as the 'ratio of microporous surface area to the overall surface area' without assigning them to samples, not coded. EDS (surface) Table 2: C 62.13, N 37.41, Na 0.46 wt%. Interlayer spacing 0.355 nm is the XRD 2theta=25 deg value the paper gives for the sample set (Sect. 4.3, 'All five samples ... exhibit similar peaks'). Basis named but not defined ('The raw data are obtained in the excess amount of hydrogen adsorbed and is normalized per mass of the adsorbent (mmol g-1)', Sect. 4.6), so basis_stated=false. Eq. 2 defines wt% as H2 mass per mass of AC x 100 (W1). H2 samples were oven-dried 80 C 12 h then vacuum-degassed 24 h (VacPrep 061); degassing temperature not stated. H2 measuring lab: acknowledgements thank non-authors for access to the H2 adsorption equipment, institution not named, so corresponding author's group used. C: pressure, uptake and digitization uncertainty are the A/B digitization means (protocol §9; match line 24). C: residual Na from the NaCl activating agent, EDS (surface) weight % from Table 2. C: the paper assigns the ~2100 cm-1 FTIR band to C≡C (Sect. 4.5) but in the next sentence notes strong diamond absorption from the ATR crystal; functional_groups records the authors' assignment.
extractor: dual extraction A (claude-sonnet-5-5) and B (claude-opus-5-5), reconciled by C (claude-opus-5-5)
